subject: Upcoming Team Building Event
body: Dear Team, I am excited to announce our upcoming team building event scheduled for next Friday. This event will be a great opportunity for us to bond, have fun, and strengthen our teamwork. We have planned various activities and games to ensure a fun and engaging experience for everyone. Please mark your calendars and come prepared for a day filled with laughter and team spirit. Looking forward to seeing you all there! Best regards, [Your Name]
